relations.title: Annex 6 — Ablation, Sufficiency and Extensibility
relations.reading: A tabletop ablation could test which coordination conditions the Tiger Team model actually depends on.

relations.title: Optimization, Coherence, and the Frame
relations.reading: The team is an integrated system when its specialist decisions preserve the same independently stated mission outcome, not merely when every member completes a local deliverable.

relations.title: The Attribution Gap and Capability Loss
relations.reading: Compressed accountability should not become concentrated blame without matching authority or visible contribution.

relations.title: Distributed Operational Intelligence Across the Americas
relations.reading: Distributed American Innovation becomes operationally intelligible when the team itself integrates field interpretation, engineering and responsibility for the receiving operation.

relations.title: Case Study: Texas-to-Mexico Oilfield Services Transformation: Knowledge Transfer, Industrialization, and Compliance
relations.reading: The oilfield deployment illustrates the team-as-system principle: legal, plant, quality and training workstreams must become one usable operating model rather than a collection of completed deliverables.
